# nanoflags_slack_destination (Resource)

A chat channel (Incoming Webhook) that receives NanoFlags events such as approval requests and publishes. The Management API has no update for destinations, so every change replaces it. The webhook URL is stored as a secret and is never returned; only `url_hint` is. Team plan and above, at most 20 per organization, admin role.

Scope: `integrations:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "releases_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "nanoflags_slack_destination" "releases" {
  name         = "#releases"
  webhook_url  = var.releases_webhook_url
  project      = "web"
  events       = ["publish.completed", "approval.requested", "flag.killed"]
  environments = ["production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) Events to deliver (1–20): `approval.requested`, `approval.decided`, `publish.completed`, `schedule.executed`, `schedule.failed`, `scenario_check.failed`, `flag.killed`, `promotion.recorded`, `webhook.failing`, `stale_flags.digest`.
- `name` (String) 1–80 characters, e.g. the channel name.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Incoming Webhook URL (`https://hooks.slack.com/services/…` or `https://hooks.slack-gov.com/…`). Write-only: never read back.

### Optional

- `environments` (Set of String) Environment keys that environment-bound events are limited to (at most 20). Empty or omitted: every environment.
- `locale` (String) Message language: `en` or `ar`. Omitted: the organization's default.
- `project` (String) Project key. Set: only that project's events. Omitted: organization-wide (organization tokens only).

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are on.
- `id` (String) Destination id (UUID).
- `status` (String) `ok`, or `failing` after 3 consecutive failed deliveries.
- `url_hint` (String) Host and last 4 characters of the URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Destination id. The webhook URL is never returned by the API: keep it in the configuration.
terraform import nanoflags_slack_destination.releases 7d9f8a52-3c1e-4b7a-9f61-2a8d4c0b5e13
```
